payload.friendly_name: ADR-0082 slices 2 to 4: one graph walk, rules from the factory
payload.purpose_context: Epic #636 migrates the charter service to ADR-0082: the packs domain owns every graph walk, the rules come from one factory and run in one walker. Slices 2 to 4 (#637, #638, #639) move the cycle, group and descending walks into PackGraph, the own-closure rules into packs.domain.rules behind a ValidationWalker, and the relation and edge-index refusals into relations-phase rules. Refusal codes, details and the order of findings stay the same; they unblock the remaining pack-check checks of #632.
payload.purpose_tldr: Move every pack-graph walk, the own-closure rules and the relation rules into the packs domain, with no change to any answer the service gives.

payload.question: D1: Walker shape for slice 3 — keep an intermediate phase runner (ValidationWalker<S> over a List<ClosureFault> ledger, rule-ordered buckets, VIOLATION gate, ClosureFacts gains declaring()/fallbackProfile(); Scope in #639, visitor driver in slice 7) or build the full GraphWalker/PackGraphNode/Scope design in #638?

D2: Edge-index refusals in #639 — move only the registration-side relation and edge-index checks into relations() and keep the read-time merge refusals (500 pack_unreadable) as they are, or unify read and registration codes (a wire change)?

options: Keep in slice 7, file the child now (recommended)
payload.question: D3: #632 item 3 — pull a narrow pack-doctor pickup (specialization cycle + relations over each root's composed closure, parity rows) into this mission as WP05, or keep it in slice 7 and file the slice-7 child now?

D4: May the runner edit #638's done-when (registration, every write and the census get the own-closure rules only from PackRulesets.ownClosure; pack-doctor in slice 7) and #639's text (name SpecializationCycleRule, the relations subject and EdgeIndex's home)?

options: ADR-0056 model: 500 on reads, 422 on impact-checked writes (recommended)
payload.question: Q-A: The unified edge-index codes (self_override, override_not_permitted) are 422 on every operation today. Follow ADR-0056 (a read keeps 500 — the configured packs are at fault — and the 13 impact-checked operations keep 422 through x-refusal operations overrides; moves both codes to the 500 default), or keep 422 everywhere (a read would answer 422 for a stored-pack fault)?

options: Out of scope; record it on epic #636 (recommended)
payload.question: Q-B: C21 (a forbidden layer override in LayerMerge) has the same split — read 500 pack_unreadable, registration twin override_not_permitted — but is not an edge-index refusal. In scope for D2's unification?

Q-C: The stray step link (another pack's requires edge to an action that is no step of the mission type in force) has no registration twin and no refusal code. Answer it with pack_reference_artifact_missing plus a mission_step_unlinked violation (C37 precedent, no new code), or add a new refusal code (a closed-enum addition)?
